flush.device.what.direct: What it does: the router drops every open connection (IPv4 and IPv6) of the device. Apps on it reconnect on their own within a few seconds, this time over the current route: direct, using the home network's real IP.
flush.device.what.proxy: What it does: the router drops every open connection (IPv4 and IPv6) of the device. Apps on it reconnect on their own within a few seconds, this time over the current route: through proxy “{proxy}”.
flush.device.what.proxyUnknown: What it does: the router drops every open connection (IPv4 and IPv6) of the device. Apps on it reconnect on their own within a few seconds, this time over the current route: through the selected proxy.
flush.device.safe: What stays the same: Wi-Fi stays connected, no data is deleted and the route does not change. Calls, videos or downloads in progress may pause for a few seconds.
flush.device.done.title: Dropped connections of {name}
flush.device.done.text: Apps on the device will reconnect over the current route.

flush.all.title: Drop all open connections?
flush.all.what: The router drops every open connection of all devices going through a proxy. Apps reconnect on their own within a few seconds over the current route.
flush.all.when: Use it after editing a proxy or re-syncing the router if you suspect old connections are still taking the wrong path.
flush.all.safe: Routes do not change, no data is deleted and Wi-Fi stays connected. Calls, videos and downloads in progress will pause for a few seconds.
flush.all.done.title: All connections dropped
flush.all.done.text: Devices will reconnect over their current route.

dd.lease.dynamicNote: The router may hand out a different IP later. Assigning a proxy pins it.
